lista.que_hace: Returns the current chain-wide occupancy summary, including sold rooms, rooms out of service and overbooking.
lista.devuelve: Object with hoteles (integer), vendidas (integer), fuera_servicio (integer) and sobreventa (integer).

lista.que_hace: Lists hotels with room counts, availability, occupancy percentage, nightly rate and distance from central Valencia.
lista.devuelve: Paginated object with items (hotel id, name, nightly rate, distance, total rooms, out-of-service rooms, sold rooms, available rooms, vacant rooms, occupancy percentage and optional out-of-service reason), total, limit and offset.

lista.que_hace: Returns pending relocation proposals, relocation history, guests who need relocation and destination hotels with availability.

entrada.limit: Optional integer page size for proposals and relocation candidates.
entrada.offset: Optional integer page offset for proposals and relocation candidates.
entrada.historial_limit: Optional integer page size for relocation history.
entrada.historial_offset: Optional integer page offset for relocation history.

lista.devuelve: Object with paginated propuestas and historial (proposal details and approval state), huespedes_por_reubicar (reservation id, guest, source hotel id and name), and destinos (hotels with availability and occupancy details).

lista.que_hace: Records a relocation proposal for a reservation at a destination hotel, with a reason. It does not approve the proposal.

entrada.motivo: Required string explaining the reason for the proposed relocation.

lista.devuelve: Object with the created proposal id (integer) and its state (string).
